sourceOfTruth: FastAPI routes in apps/api/foundry_lite_api/main.py plus SDK_CLIENT_SURFACE generated by scripts/generate_sdk_ts.py
rawRequestRule: apps/web/index.html must use named generated SDK methods for frontend-consumable surfaces; direct sdkClient().request('/api/...') calls are forbidden.

surfaces.operatorEvidence: SDK response metadata carries X-Request-ID into the Web Operations top bar.
Dataset catalog reads are tenant-scoped, permission-gated by dataset:read, and failures return typed API errors with request_id.
Dataset preview failures return typed API errors with request_id and permission/masking is enforced by application policy.
Dataset version rows expose committed version identity, transaction id, manifest, status, and request_id on failure.
Dataset inspect returns committed version, schema, manifest file, row-count, and storage profile evidence with request_id-bearing typed failures.

Dataset aggregate validates committed schema columns, masking, filters, groupBy, and metrics in application services, then executes the grouped Analytics calculation through the ComputeAdapter against pinned committed Parquet files.
Persisted dataset quality contract checks are listed through the dataset boundary and applied by later dataset commits when enabled.
Creating a quality contract check is idempotent by canonical check config, leaves audit evidence, and affects later dataset commit validation.
Updating a quality contract check leaves audit evidence, and changed enabled/config state affects later dataset commit validation.
Versioned dataset quality contracts list contract version, activation status, owner, schema reference, and snapshotted check evidence through the dataset boundary.
Creating a dataset quality contract version snapshots current check definitions and latest schema reference, then audits dataset_quality_contract.version_created.
Fetching one dataset quality contract version returns immutable check snapshot and schema reference evidence for run investigation.
Activating a dataset quality contract version supersedes the previous active version, audits dataset_quality_contract.version_activated, and pins later commit checks to that version snapshot.
Dataset quality result history returns persisted commit-time check results with manifest hash, schema-version reference, run id, transaction id, status, and check metadata.
Dataset quality result summary returns persisted commit-time check result counts by status and check type plus latest run evidence for trend/reporting surfaces.
Catalog reads are permission-gated by ontology:read and failures return typed request_id-bearing API errors.
Validation failures are typed API errors with request_id and validation details.
Ontology apply activates a new ontology version through ontology:activate, returns the new ontologyVersionId, versionNumber, and migrationPlan, and leaves ontology activation audit evidence.
Ontology rollback restores an archived version through the same ontology:activate activation path and returns rolled-back-from/to version numbers plus the migration plan as operator evidence.
Ontology resource usage is a read-only governance read model (ontology:read) returning windowed action run, index run, and audit event usage evidence for one active ontology resource.
Ontology resource dependents is a read-only governance read model (ontology:read) returning backing dataset, action, link, writeback, side-effect, and OSDK application dependency evidence.
Ontology proposal submission requires Idempotency-Key, revalidates the submitted yaml, snapshots the migration plan at submit time, and stores tenant-scoped proposal state with audit evidence.
Ontology proposal queue reads return cursor-paged tenant-scoped proposal rows with status, fingerprint, assignee, and revision evidence for the review-then-apply flow.
Ontology proposal detail returns yamlText, submitted migration plan, decision, execution status, and timeline evidence for one governance proposal.
Ontology proposal in-place revision is fingerprint-gated (expectedFingerprint conditional update), revalidates the new yaml, and records revision count/timeline evidence.
Ontology proposal reviewer assignment records the reviewer on the tenant-scoped proposal row and leaves assignment audit evidence for separation-of-duties review.

Ontology proposal approve/reject re-validates against the current active ontology, is fingerprint-gated, enforces separation of duties (ontology:activate), and records the decision with comment evidence.
Ontology proposal execution applies an approved fingerprint-matched proposal through the same activation path as direct apply and records the applied ontology version as execution evidence.
Ontology proposal withdrawal by its submitter records the withdrawal reason and timestamp on the proposal timeline without touching the active ontology version.

Ontology branch creation requires Idempotency-Key, snapshots the active ontology version as the branch base and working copy, and replays the same open branch for the same name/creator instead of duplicating it.
Ontology branch list is a cursor-paged tenant-scoped read returning per-branch status, contentFingerprint, and baseStale drift against the current active ontology version.
Ontology branch detail returns the working-copy yamlText, base snapshot baseYamlText, contentFingerprint for CAS mutations, and the baseStale drift flag.
Ontology branch content update is fingerprint-gated (expectedFingerprint conditional update), size-bounded, structurally validated, and never touches the active catalog.
Ontology branch diff classifies every resource three ways (branch vs base vs current active), lists per-resource conflicts, and carries the merge-time migration plan for the UI.
Ontology branch rebase re-anchors the branch on the current active ontology under an expectedFingerprint CAS guard with explicit per-resource conflict resolutions (use main|branch).

Ontology branch propose requires Idempotency-Key, enforces an up-to-date (rebased) base, submits the branch content through the existing proposal governance flow, and replays the live proposal for identical content.
Ontology branch abandon terminally closes an open branch (creator or ontology:activate holder), frees its name for reuse, and replays idempotently once abandoned.
Branch Action Type list returns canonical v3 contracts, deterministic parameter schemas, form layout, inline eligibility, and the branch fingerprint without exposing active Ontology mutations.
Branch Action Type detail projects the stored definition and the server-compiled contract, JSON Schema, fingerprint, and inline eligibility from one source of truth.

Branch Action Type create requires Idempotency-Key and expectedFingerprint, validates the full candidate ontology, writes only the branch working copy, and replays identical content without another audit mutation.
Branch Action Type update requires path-definition identity, Idempotency-Key, full-candidate validation, and expectedFingerprint CAS before replacing the branch resource.
Branch Action Type delete requires Idempotency-Key and expectedFingerprint, removes only the branch resource, and replays a completed deletion without modifying active Ontology state.
AIP Builder drafts are validated through a read-only preflight that pins context partitions, governed tool effects, Logic DAG shape, eval axes, and request_id-bearing typed failures before release.
AIP Builder drafts are validated before runtime execution, then linked to an AI Operations run detail with context/tool/proposal evidence instead of bypassing ToolBroker or Approval-to-Action guards.
AIP Agent Runtime retrieves authorized context, compiles a governed prompt, calls Model Gateway, and links the read-only model turn to an AI Operations run detail with context/model/usage evidence.
AI FDE exposes only server-owned modes and tools that pass the invoking user's normal platform permissions, including data, source, function, governance, ML, OSDK React, and platform Q&A surfaces.

AI FDE executes a bounded cross-domain model-tool loop as the invoking user, supports lazy tool search and explicit workspace attachments, requires named mutation approval, keeps Ontology and Pipeline edits branch-first, and links structured plan, clarification, model, tool, usage, and proposal evidence to AI Operations.

Pilot planning deterministically describes the Project, seed Dataset, Ontology resources, OSDK resource scopes, React application, CI commands, and the generation approval required before any resource is created.

An explicit Idempotency-Key creates one Project, replay-safe seed Dataset version, isolated Ontology branch, restricted OSDK application, OSDK-backed React source bundle, CI workflow, and durable Pilot resource.
The generated application bundle is reloaded through the permission-scoped Resource catalog and powers its stable project application path without activating the draft Ontology.

Citation navigation accepts only a signed opaque navigationRef, re-verifies tenant-scoped committed evidence server-side, and returns source version, content hash, page, bbox, timecode, processor/model pins, and security envelope without trusting URL coordinates.
AIP eval runs persist deterministic suite/case/result evidence and write ai.eval_run.completed audit/outbox evidence before release promotion.
AIP release promotion is gated by a passed eval run and leaves ai.agent_release.promoted audit/outbox evidence.
Media set creation stores tenant-scoped catalog metadata used by later immutable media transactions and media-reference bindings.
Media set reads return the catalog row that scopes upload, processing, and retrieval policy decisions.
Opening a media transaction requires Idempotency-Key and returns the durable mediaTransactionId used for byte staging and commit evidence.
Media upload stages real file bytes into an open transaction and returns the immutable staged mediaItemVersionId before serving truth is committed.
Media commit atomically flips staged versions to COMMITTED, advances logical-path heads, and writes media.transaction.committed audit/outbox evidence.
Media processing is pinned to one committed mediaItemVersionId and returns derivative/run evidence for OCR, ASR, video, or image processors.

The authenticated SDK read preserves bearer token and request context, resolves only an immutable committed media version after media-read and classification-clearance checks, verifies storage hash and size, and returns bytes for a caller-owned blob preview.
Committed derivative reads expose the processing output pinned to its source media version and processor spec hash.
Document Intelligence reads a tenant-scoped, ordinal-paginated projection of committed content units with page, bbox, source locator, structure, confidence, and timecode evidence.
Derivative indexing projects committed content units into a named search generation while content units remain the serving truth.
Content search re-reads authoritative content units and returns source media version, content unit, text hash, and classification citation evidence.
Visual derivative indexing projects committed frame embeddings into a CLIP-pinned generation while derivative/content-unit DB rows remain serving truth.
Text content generation promotion records audit evidence before an indexed generation becomes the active query source; indexing alone never makes an upload searchable.
Visual generation promotion records audit evidence before a CLIP visual generation becomes the active query source.
Visual search requires media:search RBAC, embeds the text query through the CLIP text tower, and returns only authoritative tenant-scoped content-unit hits.
Media processing run list shows newest processing attempts, including FAILED rows that operators can inspect without treating run status as serving truth.
Media processing run detail returns the specific run evidence, derivative pointer, and typed failure reason for an operator drill-down.
The server-owned processor catalog exposes exact processor, adapter, model, format, output, preview, and resource capability metadata without browser hard-coding.
Media reference binding requires Idempotency-Key and pins an Ontology holder property to one immutable mediaItemVersionId.
Media reference resolution applies classification clearance and returns the exact immutable media reference currently bound to an Ontology holder property.
Insight review queue reads return durable review state backed by tenant-scoped rows and request_id-bearing typed failures.
Insight review creation requires Idempotency-Key, stores tenant-scoped review state, and writes insight_review.created audit evidence.
Insight review detail is tenant-scoped and returns evidence/action proposal state with request_id-bearing typed failures.
Insight review assignment requires Idempotency-Key, refuses terminal reviews, and writes insight_review.assigned audit evidence.
Insight approve/reject requires Idempotency-Key, has one terminal winner, and writes insight_review.approved or insight_review.rejected audit evidence.
Approval execution requires Idempotency-Key, persists the execution claim, recovers same-key retries after action success, and rejects key reuse for a different request.
Object get can include sourceRunChain/propertyLineage/lateDataBadge evidence and typed request_id failures.
Link traversal returns target-missing warnings and request_id-bearing errors.
Object query returns cursor/stale-search projection evidence and masks sensitive properties through policy.
ObjectSet subscription streams send a masked snapshot, watermark, object_changed events, and out_of_date evidence through the same object query permission path.
Server-side object aggregation returns grouped count/sum/avg/min/max metrics computed inside the object read boundary so masked or filtered rows never reach the browser.
Interface-scoped polymorphic query unions every implementing object type through the same object query permission and masking path and returns one merged page.
Registered ontology function execution runs the read/compute-only Logic DAG through ToolBroker guards and returns logicRunId, aiRunId, status, output, and resultHash run evidence.
Object set reads preserve tenant/user accessScope, lifecycle, visibility compatibility, and request_id failures.
Object set mutation runs through application policy, audit-on-mutation gates, and explicit accessScope/lifecycle validation.
Object set detail preserves membership evidence, accessScope/lifecycle semantics, and request_id failures.
SQL transform registration stores the SQL body as a server-managed artifact after permission/restore-mode guards, then writes transform.definition audit evidence.
Transform run returns committed dataset version/transaction/manifest identity and leaves transform run lineage evidence in Operations.
Transform scheduler preview compares registered snapshot transforms against latest input dataset versions and returns due/skip reasons without starting runs.

Transform scheduler tick starts bounded snapshot rebuilds only when latest input dataset versions differ from the latest successful transform run, while append/incremental transforms stay fail-closed for manual execution.
The server-owned Graph v2 descriptor catalog exposes named ports, artifact kinds, configuration fields, specification versions, and honest runtime availability.
The reusable trained-model catalog exposes model API input and output schemas, branch-latest resolution, batch-only execution, resource coordinates, and the explicit preview limitation.
Pipeline branch creation is tenant scoped, requires an Idempotency-Key, is audit logged, and starts a graph editing workspace.
Pipeline branch list gives the canvas branch picker bounded tenant-scoped rows.
Pipeline branch detail returns graph, layout, output contract, and CAS fingerprint.
Graph updates store nodes, edges, layout, tests, schedule, and output contract through CAS fingerprint.
Branch diff reports base/current/latest graph fingerprint changes before review.
Branch rebase refreshes the base graph under CAS so stale edits are visible before proposal.
Branch proposal validates the graph and submits the design to operator review with required Idempotency-Key evidence.
Branch abandon closes open draft work without changing deployed versions.
Graph validation returns cycle, dangling edge, node type, and output contract diagnostics.
Cast suggestions give the column casting panel bounded schema hints without committing data.
Node preview is bounded, tenant scoped, and no-commit for the canvas preview panel.
Node stats returns bounded preview metadata for graph inspection panels.
Graph tests persist a tenant-scoped test result for review evidence.
Preview creation accepts an unsaved Graph v2 draft, persists bounded no-commit evidence, and requires Idempotency-Key before asynchronous execution starts.
Preview detail exposes status, bounded outputs, artifacts, error evidence, and the explicit commitForbidden and servingVersionCreated boundary.
Preview cancellation preserves the durable preview row while requesting a terminal non-serving cancellation state.
Proposal list backs the operator review queue with bounded tenant rows.
Proposal detail returns review status, graph fingerprint, and graph snapshot.
Proposal assignment moves submitted work into review with audit evidence.
Proposal decision records approve/reject state before executable versions are minted.
Executing an approved proposal creates an immutable pipeline version and marks the branch merged.
Withdrawal closes proposed work without creating a deployable version.
Version detail returns immutable graph snapshot and deployment evidence.
Run detail returns pipeline run status, output dataset identity, and timeline evidence.
Cursor-based history returns durable queued, active, and terminal Pipeline runs without relying on in-memory worker state.
Durable SSE resumes from Last-Event-ID and streams only persisted state transitions; connection heartbeats are not stored as run events.
Run timeline exposes compile and node execution events for build timeline UI.
Run cancel persists the Idempotency-Key and cancelling request in the DB before signalling Temporal. Pending work stops, while already committed immutable outputs remain visible as evidence.
Schedule preview evaluates persisted nextDueAt, active state, and expired lease conditions without starting runs or mutating scheduler state.
Schedule tick atomically claims due rows with a lease and monotonic fencing token, then starts one deployed-version run per deterministic schedule slot idempotency key.
Version list gives deploy screens bounded version history for one pipeline.
Deployment history exposes immutable compiled plans, compiler and model or processor pins, promotion identity, fingerprints, and rollback lineage for one pipeline.
Deploy requires Idempotency-Key, compiles an approved version into an immutable deployment record, and replays the same request without creating a duplicate deployment.

Run start requires Idempotency-Key, stores the immutable plan and all node rows first, returns queued with 202 by default, and optionally waits at most 30 seconds without executing nodes in the API process.
Schedule upsert requires Idempotency-Key, validates cron or interval plus IANA timezone, binds a deployed version, and persists nextDueAt, status, failure policy, and audit/outbox evidence.
Schedule get returns the current typed definition, active or paused state, next due slot, lease/fencing state, and last failure evidence for the deploy screen.
Schedule pause requires Idempotency-Key, preserves the typed definition and next slot evidence, clears any outstanding lease, and stops new automatic claims.
Schedule resume requires Idempotency-Key, resets the next trigger anchor from current time, clears failure count, and returns active state without rewriting the deployed version.
Schedule delete requires Idempotency-Key, replays the original result for the same operator intent, and removes future automatic starts without deleting versions or runs.
Operations run list contains grouped run/audit/outbox/DLQ/AI evidence and cursor metadata, including aiRuns for canonical AI execution ledger rows.
Lineage reads are tenant-scoped and return persisted lineage edge rows for dataset/object/run drill-down with request_id-bearing typed failures.
Detector reports carry incident evidence links, thresholds, and active/suppressed status.
Detector reports can be recorded into durable observability_incidents rows with audit/outbox evidence while preserving the read-only detect route.
Stored incidents are listed by tenant and lifecycle status for recovery-console evidence without raw route construction.
Operators can acknowledge a stored incident through a typed SDK method that records lifecycle audit/outbox evidence.
Operators can resolve a stored incident with a reason while preserving recurrence/reopen evidence for later detector runs.

Admin overview separates current API surfaces, worker entrypoints, CLI-only migration execution, runbook-only bootstrap, and future visual workspace scope, including executionSurface, canStartFromBrowser, approval, checklist, and blockingReason fields so frontend admin screens do not overclaim backend control.

Admin task plan turns migration, worker daemon, infra bootstrap, bounded outbox, and future workspace capabilities into screen-ready tasks with browser-run, operator-approval, command, checklist, required-backend-surface, and blocking evidence fields.
Preflight report includes dataset/storage mismatch issues, restore gates, high-watermarks, and audit evidence.

Backup artifact creation persists a ready preflight report as an immutable local restore artifact, returns a content hash receipt, rejects blocked preflight evidence, replays the same backup id receipt idempotently, and keeps the artifact store immutable against same-id payload overwrite.

Verified artifact restore entrypoint reads the immutable artifact, verifies its receipt hash, checks that artifact versions still match the current serving head, starts restore-mode only when safe, and records post-restore validation evidence without claiming execution on this validation-only route.

Historical artifact restore execution verifies the immutable backup artifact, copies the sealed source dataset files into new snapshot dataset versions, commits restore transactions as the latest serving heads, and returns restored dataset version evidence without deleting later versions.
Restore mode status is durable and blocks side-effect retry/reprocess entrypoints while paused.
Restore mode status exposes traffic pause flags, high-watermarks, and blocking issue counts.
Post-restore validation leaves durable audit evidence before resume approval can reopen retry/reprocess entrypoints.
Resume approval leaves audit evidence and requires post-restore validation artifacts.
Recovery overview joins latest preflight, active restore-mode traffic gates, and next operator actions into one read model.
Bounded admin outbox publish returns requested/published/failed/skipped counts plus event ids and DLQ ids, while the backend operation leaves durable outbox status and audit evidence.

Run detail returns investigation, normalized error, related audit/outbox/object edit, lineage, dataset transaction, sourceEvidence for sync runs, quality evidence, and for runType=ai a safe AI ledger detail with events, model/tool/context/citation/usage summary and trace metadata.
Prompt artifact access is separate from the safe AI run detail and requires the aip_prompt_artifact_reader role before plaintext is returned.
Connection create requires Idempotency-Key, stores only secretRef auth metadata, returns configFingerprint, and writes connector.connection.created audit evidence.
Connection list is tenant-scoped and returns saved REST connector configuration fingerprints plus registered resources without raw secret values.
Connection get is tenant-scoped and returns one connector with resource configuration and configFingerprint evidence without raw secret values.
Connection update requires Idempotency-Key, rewrites configFingerprint, keeps auth secretRef-only, and writes connector.connection.updated audit evidence.
Resource upsert requires Idempotency-Key, ensures the target dataset, rejects primary-key mismatch, returns resource configFingerprint, and writes connector.resource.upserted audit evidence.
Resource test reads the external REST source, returns schema/sample/error evidence, writes connector.resource.tested audit evidence, and does not create a dataset commit.
Resource sync start requires Idempotency-Key and stores datasetRef, connectorName, resourceName, syncName, and configFingerprint in the workflow input for fail-closed activity execution.
OSDK application creation requires Idempotency-Key, stores app/client/resource grants tenant-scoped, and audits osdk.application.created.
OSDK applications list is tenant-scoped and exposes app/client/resource registry state without raw secret material.
OSDK application get returns current active clients and granted ontology resources for app/resource-scope review.
OSDK application resource updates require Idempotency-Key, replace app grants atomically, and audit osdk.application.resources_updated.

Ontology MCP publication configuration requires Idempotency-Key and stays disabled until an operator stores an enabled state, Markdown tool description, and application Origin allowlist; replay returns the same durable row and every change is audited.
The application MCP configuration read shows publication state, description, allowed browser Origins, update actor, and activity evidence without any OAuth secret material.
The tenant MCP Hub lists each configured server with application identity, endpoint, resource count, auth modes, allowlisted Origins, status, and last-activity placeholder.
SDK version creation requires Idempotency-Key, snapshots app resource scope, applies semver compatibility policy, writes local TS/Python artifact hash, and audits release status.
SDK version list returns local release history, compatibility decision, ontology fingerprint, resource snapshot, and artifact hash references.
SDK version get returns one release row with its local artifact metadata for compatibility and package audit review.
SDK artifact read returns the local registry artifact content and DB-persisted sha256 hash for release verification.
Project list returns only tenant-scoped projects visible through project grants, including discoverer-visible project discovery state.
Project creation requires Idempotency-Key, creates a stable project RID, assigns the creator owner grant, and records audit/outbox evidence.
Project detail is tenant-scoped and grant-gated so a project acts as a permission boundary rather than just a folder.
Project grant list exposes the owner/editor/viewer/discoverer permission boundary for the selected project.
Project grant upsert is owner/admin-only, idempotent, and stores user/role/group-compatible grant rows while local v1 evaluates user and role grants. Requires Idempotency-Key.
Folder list reads a project-scoped tree without hidden backfill writes and inherits the selected project's grants.
Folder creation requires editor/owner project permission, Idempotency-Key, a stable folder RID, and audit/outbox evidence.
Folder move changes only the organizing tree, keeps the folder inside the same project permission boundary, and records mutation evidence. Requires Idempotency-Key.
Folder trash is an idempotent project-scoped mutation that hides the folder from normal lists without deleting its RID identity. Requires Idempotency-Key.
Folder restore reactivates a trashed folder under inherited project grants while preserving its stable folder RID. Requires Idempotency-Key.
Resource search returns RID-backed datasets, sources, ontology resources, and registered work products visible through inherited project grants without query-time backfill.
Resource detail resolves a stable RID and verifies the caller can view the containing project before returning metadata.
Resource registration requires project editor permission, stores a stable RID plus sourceSurface/sourceRef link, and records audit/outbox evidence. Requires Idempotency-Key.
Resource move requires edit rights on both the current and destination project boundaries, then updates project/folder placement for the same RID. Requires Idempotency-Key.
Resource trash is an idempotent soft-delete state change that preserves RID identity and hides the item from normal resource lists. Requires Idempotency-Key.
Resource restore reactivates a trashed RID-backed item under the same inherited project permission boundary. Requires Idempotency-Key.
Favorite set stores per-user resource favorite state after the project view permission check and returns the same resource item with isFavorite=true. Requires Idempotency-Key.
Favorite delete removes only the caller's favorite row and leaves the RID-backed resource unchanged. Requires Idempotency-Key.
Trash list is the SDK view of resource search with includeTrashed enabled, preserving grant checks while showing recoverable items.
Trash restore is the trash-screen alias for the same RID restore mutation and requires edit permission on the containing project. Requires Idempotency-Key.

Admin reconcile is the explicit backfill/repair path for existing datasets, sources, ontology resources, and registered work products; list/search never performs hidden writes. Requires Idempotency-Key.
Local OSDK OAuth authorize validates active app/client, redirect URI, PKCE challenge, and requested resource scopes before returning a short-lived code without storing raw code material.
Local OSDK OAuth token exchange verifies one-time authorization code plus PKCE and returns a JWT access token with tenant/user/app/client/scope claims plus rotating refresh token.
Local OSDK OAuth refresh rotates the hashed refresh token, denies reuse, and emits raw-token-free audit evidence.
Local OSDK OAuth revoke closes the refresh token and session so later refresh attempts fail closed without exposing raw token values.
Developer Console client creation requires Idempotency-Key and stores redirect URIs, allowed scopes, active status, and token TTLs tenant-scoped for local OAuth sessions.
Developer Console client list returns registered OSDK OAuth clients and scope metadata for one tenant-scoped app.
Developer Console client update requires Idempotency-Key and changes redirect URIs, allowed scopes, TTLs, and status with audit evidence.
Developer Console client deactivation requires Idempotency-Key, fail-closes new OAuth authorization for that client, and leaves audit evidence.

Developer Console requires Idempotency-Key, rotates one confidential-client credential, returns the raw value once, persists only version metadata, rotates the prior version, and records tenant-scoped audit evidence.
Developer Console requires Idempotency-Key, revokes the current confidential-client credential so it cannot mint another token, and records the revocation without exposing secret material.
Developer Console returns active, rotated, and revoked secret-version metadata plus last-use timestamps without returning a credential value.
SDK channel promotion requires Idempotency-Key and assigns a released TS/Python SDK version to stable, beta, or latest with tenant-scoped audit evidence.
SDK release channel list exposes channel to version assignment for local install and compatibility review.
SDK compatibility window creation requires Idempotency-Key, records old-to-new version support, and lets removed app scopes remain as deprecated grants until supportedUntil.
SDK compatibility window list shows active old/new support intervals for app developers and release operators.
SDK install metadata combines version rows, release channels, and compatibility windows for local package installation workflows.
SDK artifact download token creation requires Idempotency-Key and returns a short-lived scoped token while only token hashes are persisted.
SDK artifact download by scoped token returns local registry bytes once and marks the token used without exposing token hashes.
Unified Source list is tenant-scoped and merges product Source registry rows with REST connector read models without exposing raw secret values.
Source get returns one tenant-scoped Source read model with configFingerprint, safe configSummary, last commit/workflow pointers, and operationsPath when available.

Source lifecycle update requires Idempotency-Key and the current config fingerprint, keeps Source history intact, blocks new manual and scheduled sync runs while disabled, and records source.disabled or source.enabled audit and outbox evidence.

Source connection test requires Idempotency-Key and the current config fingerprint, performs a live REST preview or SQL SELECT 1 without creating a Dataset commit, and persists redacted step, requestId, audit, and outbox evidence.
Source connection-test history is tenant-scoped, survives browser refresh and backend service reconstruction, and returns only redacted diagnostic evidence with requestId correlation.

Source egress history derives durable TCP route evidence from persisted connection tests and exposes connectionId, responseFlags, byte counts, duration, destination port, origin, network type, policy, Agent, and requestId without credential values.

Source Wizard template list returns product source types, capability hints, credential modes, network modes, exploration support, and managed run modes so a frontend can render the first connection choice without raw route calls.
Source credential create requires Idempotency-Key, stores the secret in the local vault, persists only the secretRef/version and safe configFingerprint, and returns a redacted credential view.
Credential list is tenant-scoped and returns credential names, status, fingerprints, and redacted secretRefs without exposing raw secret values.
Credential get returns one tenant-scoped, redacted credential view with configFingerprint and secretRef metadata only.
Source agent register requires Idempotency-Key and records customer-network/VPN agent capabilities, network summary, heartbeat status, and configFingerprint for private source access demos.
Agent list is tenant-scoped and shows registered source agents, network summaries, capabilities, and last heartbeat evidence for private network readiness.
Agent heartbeat updates lastHeartbeatAt and gives the wizard live readiness evidence before using an agent-proxy network policy.
Network policy create requires Idempotency-Key and stores direct or agent_proxy access policy, allowed host summary, agent linkage, and configFingerprint for source connection evidence.
Network policy list is tenant-scoped and returns safe policy summaries so a frontend can show which source paths are direct or agent-proxied.
Source exploration reads the external source for schema/sample evidence, records an explorationRunId and operationsPath, and does not create a dataset commit.
Managed sync create requires Idempotency-Key, stores Source-to-dataset/media target, capability, mode, schedule summary, safe configSummary, checkpoint, and configFingerprint.
Managed sync list returns tenant-scoped sync definitions with last run/workflow pointers and checkpoints for operational dashboards.
Managed sync get returns one sync definition with configFingerprint, checkpoint, target dataset/media set, and last run pointers for resume/retry decisions.
Managed sync run start requires Idempotency-Key, creates/replays a sync run, captures checkpoint start/end, dataset version or workflowRunId, result/error payload, and operationsPath evidence.

Schedule update requires Idempotency-Key, validates manual, disabled, interval, or cron configuration, rejects stale config fingerprints, and records before/after audit evidence with the idempotency correlation key.
Pause requires Idempotency-Key and a current config fingerprint, preserves the recurring schedule, stops automatic triggers, and records before/after audit evidence.
Resume requires Idempotency-Key and a current config fingerprint, resets the recurring trigger anchor, preserves interval/cron configuration, and records before/after audit evidence.
Managed sync run list returns operational history for one sync, including status, checkpoints, workflow/dataset version pointers, and error evidence.
Managed sync run get returns a durable run evidence row with request, checkpoint, commit/workflow, operationsPath, and redacted error details.

Streaming start requires Idempotency-Key and the current config fingerprint, records a durable SourceStreamingSyncWorkflow intent, links it from the sync, and preserves auditable desired-state evidence for a worker lease takeover.

Streaming stop requires Idempotency-Key, records a durable cancellation request without advancing the Kafka checkpoint, keeps the last worker telemetry, and writes source.streaming_sync.stop_requested audit evidence.

Streaming status returns desired and observed lifecycle state, lease freshness, heartbeat, checkpoint, Kafka lag, throughput, reconnect, upstream, Dataset version, and redacted error evidence without mutating runtime state.

Scheduler due preview evaluates active managed sync schedules without starting runs and returns due/skip reasons, slot idempotency keys, next due timestamps, and maxRuns evidence for Source Wizard scheduling controls.

Scheduler tick evaluates active managed sync schedules, reconciles terminal workflow-backed source runs, starts due scheduled runs through the managed sync boundary, and returns started/skipped evidence for daemon or operator execution.

CSV upload requires Idempotency-Key, sends browser file bytes as multipart, commits through the dataset transaction path, returns commitResult and operationsPath evidence, and stores a content-hash Source fingerprint.
Batch file upload requires Idempotency-Key, sends a manifest plus repeated file parts, commits each browser-provided file under one Source intent, and records commitResults in Source lastCommitRef.
Webhook listener create requires Idempotency-Key, stores listener URL, dataset target, connector/resource names, and signingSecretRef only; raw signing keys are never accepted or returned.
Webhook listener get returns safe listener metadata and required headers for inbound integration without exposing signing secret values.
Debezium Source create requires Idempotency-Key, persists stream/topic/consumer group and secretRefs only, ensures the target dataset, and returns Source configFingerprint evidence.

Debezium operationPlan returns source readiness, CDC archive/object-indexer worker commands, ontology CDC backing expectations, and operator checklist evidence without provisioning external Debezium infrastructure from the browser.
